script.problem: It has 2 sentences. Explanations are 3 to 5 sentences.

terra.problem: “I'm staying close to the text here” comments on how Papa Dorin is telling the passage.
The explanation says the Bible never mentions a sword, but it does, including in Matthew 26:52.
The passage does not mention fire, but that does not establish that there is no fire anywhere in the scene.
“Same crowd” conflates the soldiers with the people passing by the cross.
Jesus' clothes are His own, but the text does not say whether they are new.
The passage does not say Simon went out that morning or that carrying the cross was not his idea. Being forced does not establish either detail.
“He says no” suggests Jesus spoke, but the text says He refused to drink it without saying He spoke.
“Matthew just states it plainly, and I'll do the same” comments on how Papa Dorin is telling the passage.
The leaders say Jesus made the statement, but the passage does not say whom He told. “He told people” supplies an audience.
